newsitem.title: DUBAI: Qatar to finalise synthetic oil project.
newsitem.headline: Qatar to finalise synthetic oil project.

text.p: Qatar is expected to complete a proposal to use a part of its natural gas reserve in the huge North Field to make synthetic oil, an official said on Saturday.

"We consider this to be a pioneering project and land has been set aside for the proposed venture at the Ras Laffan industrial city," an official at the state-run Qatar General Petroleum Corp (QGPC) told Reuters.
He said the project involves the setting up of a gas-to- liquids conversion plant to transform methane-rich gas into synthetic crude, using a catalytic process.
The main product will be a high-quality synthetic oil which is free of most of the impurities found in conventional crude oil, said the official.
The official did not put a price tag on the project.
Qatar has said it will invest $4.98 billion over the next four years in several oil and gas downstream ventures.
